item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 14/Jan/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong today. Temperatures will rise slightly over the region. Meanwhile, a band of clouds will cover the coastal areas and the northern part of the South China Sea. The northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China tomorrow. Temperatures will fall over the region. It will be fine and dry with rather cool mornings over the coastal areas in the following couple of days. The monsoon will moderate slightly over the weekend.
